Leaves, and most other plants on Earth, are green because the pigments that help them photosynthesize, chlorophyll a and chlorophyll b, absorb light in the red/blue wavelengths in the visible spectrum, while they reflect the colors inbetween, appearing to us as green. So the color isn't reliant on the light source itself but rather its interactions with the pigments inside the plants.

There are some alternative pigments used by organisms other than chlorophyll, and their colors are different as a result. Carotenoids are one such pigment, which reflect reddish orange pigments and absorb the rest. This pigment gives carrots their orange color. You can read up on these pigments and others here.

There he is. Blood curdling screams of agony. His friends who escaped the car emotionally melting down on either side of me. All you can see is a thrashing dark silloughet amognst the flames. And then, somehow, it dies down a bit.

I run in. Grab onto his arm and yank with all my might trying to free him from this hell. But he is so mangled In the dash that his skin. His hot, gooey, skin peels off his arm and into my hands. That, was detrimental.

I didn't loose it at this point. I shut down.

I walked away from the fire and let him burn. I could do nothing. The fire swelled once more until you could barely seem him. And then his screaming stopped. But his friends did not.

And then emergency crews could be heard in the distance. Me standing there, still not fully comprehending what just happened. I snap out of it to the flashing lights and am EMT yelling at me "Where is the other car!"

Holy shit! There was another car! I take off running in the direction I thought it would have gone. What I find is an older boxy Volvo station wagon with the front left wheel smeared almost all the way to the back seat. Inside I find a very bloody barely conscious woman. And I proceed to ask the dumbest question of my entire life. "Are you OK?"

"Nno"

Little 16 year old me was shaking for weeks after that. But I know there's gnarlier stuff out there. The woman came out of it relatively OK. Had to remove her spleen and had quite a few broken bones. The guy, yeah. He didn't make it. The screams of someone burning alive while his friends wale beside you is not something you forget.
